title: Records vault entry during a busy shift

provenance.notes: Development seed family. Contains the sponsor's slide-8 exchange (EX-1 to EX-3): 'Why did you enter?' / 'It was a busy shift'; the corroboration path is the work order and the timeline (radio log, alarm history). Fictional agency, facility and people.

facts.statement: Two of the four Facilities technicians scheduled for the 13:30-22:00 shift on 12 March 2026 were absent, leaving the shift short-staffed.
At 14:01 Ines Marrow radioed Jordan Pell and asked him to check a humidity alarm in the B wing.
At 14:07 Jordan Pell's badge opened the door of Records Vault B-12.
Pell's badge has Records Vault B-12 access through the Environmental Response access group.
Records Vault B-12 is not on Pell's daily task roster, and his badge had last opened B-12 on 19 November 2025.
The B-12 door was held open from 14:09 to 14:12, raising a door-held alarm; the policy limit is 60 seconds.
Ines Marrow created work order WO-4478, assigned to Pell, at 14:31.
On short-staffed shifts Marrow logs work orders after the work is done, from the alarm panel history.
The B-12 exit does not require a badge, so no exit time was recorded.
Pell left B-12 at 14:24.
At 16:00 the vault custodian's end-of-day roster check flagged Pell's 14:07 entry as an access exception.
Marrow does not remember which room she named on the 14:01 radio call.
At 13:58 the building panel raised a high-humidity alarm for Records Vault B-12.
Marrow's 14:01 radio call named Room B-12.
Pell entered B-12 to respond to the humidity alarm Marrow had dispatched him to.
Inside B-12, Pell found the dehumidifier tripped, reset it and emptied its full condensate tank.
Pell propped the B-12 door with a cart from 14:09 to 14:12 while he wheeled the condensate tank to the corridor drain.
The B-12 humidity alarm cleared at 14:16.
At 14:25 Pell radioed Marrow that the B-12 dehumidifier was reset and the tank emptied.
WO-4478 lists Room B-12 and the task 'humidity alarm; dehumidifier reset; condensate tank emptied'.
Pell did not open or handle any sealed records box in B-12.
At the 16:10 seal audit all 214 sealed boxes in B-12 matched the seal register.
At 13:58 the building panel raised a high-humidity alarm for Room B-10, the supply room next to the vault.
Marrow's 14:01 radio call named Room B-10.
Pell reset the B-10 dehumidifier, and the B-10 alarm cleared at 14:04.
At 14:05 Pell radioed Marrow 'B-10 done'.
Pell had no assigned task in Records Vault B-12 on 12 March.
Inside B-12, Pell broke the seal on box ACQ-117 and read the bid evaluation sheets for the Annex parking-lot resurfacing contract.
Pell's cousin co-owns Ostrander Paving, one of the bidders for the Annex parking-lot resurfacing contract.
With the B-10 job finished early and the shift short-staffed, no one expected to hear from Pell until his next call.
Pell propped the B-12 door with a cart from 14:09 to 14:12 so he could hear anyone coming along the corridor.
At 14:15 Pell took seal #55419 from the vault supply drawer and resealed box ACQ-117 with it.
WO-4478 lists Room B-10 and the task 'humidity alarm; dehumidifier reset'.
At the 16:10 seal audit box ACQ-117 carried seal #55419 instead of registered seal #55102, and the supply drawer log showed #55419 removed at 14:15 with no custodian release.

dimension_notes.clarity_neutrality: Credit open, single questions about the task and the door. 'Why did you go in without a work order?' presumes a fact not yet established.

dimension_notes.evidence_based_followup: Credit requesting rec-01-rec-03 and asking about room names and times against them; credit rec-04 once available.
dimension_notes.testing_alternatives: Credit testing the dispatch explanation against the radio log and alarm history before closing.
dimension_notes.supported_closure: Truthful closure cites rec-02, or rec-01 with rec-03, together with Pell's account. 'Insufficient evidence' before rec-02 or rec-03 is reasonable if it names them (EX-3).

evidence_artifacts.description: End-of-day seal audit by the vault custodian: sealed boxes checked against the seal register, and the seal supply drawer log.

material_contradictions.description: The radio log and alarm history put the dispatched task in B-10, finished by 14:05, before the 14:07 B-12 entry.
material_contradictions.resolution: The B-12 entry had no task; the B-10 job is a true account that does not explain B-12.

material_contradictions.description: If Pell gives the humidity job as the reason for entering B-12, the account conflicts with the B-10 records; asserting it outright is forbidden assertion x:01 or x:02.
The seal on ACQ-117 was replaced at 14:15, while Pell was the only badge-holder in B-12 (14:07 to 14:24).
material_contradictions.resolution: The box was opened during Pell's entry.

decisive_support.description: The radio log shows the dispatch was to B-10 and 'B-10 done' at 14:05, before the 14:07 B-12 entry, and Pell gives no B-12 task when asked.
The seal audit shows box ACQ-117 resealed with a supply-drawer seal at 14:15, during Pell's time in B-12.

unsupported_grounds: The door-held alarm on its own
The work order being created after the entry
B-12 not being on Pell's usual roster

key_questions.intent: Establish the purpose of the B-12 entry (EX-1, EX-2).
key_questions.neutral_example: What task required entry to B-12?

key_questions.intent: Establish how the task was assigned and which room was named.
key_questions.neutral_example: How did you receive that task, and which room were you given?

key_questions.intent: Establish what he did inside the vault, in order.
key_questions.neutral_example: Walk me through what you did inside B-12, step by step.

key_questions.intent: Establish why the door was held open.
key_questions.neutral_example: What was happening at the door between 14:09 and 14:12?

key_questions.intent: Establish when he left and what came next.
key_questions.neutral_example: When did you leave B-12, and what did you do next?

alternative_explanations.hypothesis: He was dispatched to the vault for a facilities task.
alternative_explanations.test: Request the radio log and the work order; compare the room and time with his account.

alternative_explanations.hypothesis: The door was held open to move equipment.
alternative_explanations.test: Ask what he moved and check it against the work-order task.

alternative_explanations.hypothesis: He entered B-12 for something other than his task.
alternative_explanations.test: Request the alarm history and the seal audit; compare the alarm room and clear time with the 14:07 entry.

dimension_notes.clarity_neutrality: Credit open, single questions about the task and the door. 'Why did you go in without a work order?' presumes a fact not yet established.
dimension_notes.response_relevance: 'It was a busy shift' leaves the purpose of entry unanswered; credit recognizing that and asking for the task (EX-2).
dimension_notes.evidence_based_followup: Credit requesting rec-01-rec-03 and asking about room names and times against them; credit rec-04 once available.
dimension_notes.testing_alternatives: Credit testing the dispatch explanation against the radio log and alarm history before closing.
dimension_notes.supported_closure: Deceptive closure cites rec-02 (B-10 dispatch and 'B-10 done' before the 14:07 entry) with his non-answers on the B-12 purpose, or rec-04. Demeanor is never a ground.

turn_label_guide.situation: Answers 'Why did you enter?' with 'It was a busy shift' or by describing the B-10 job.
turn_label_guide.label: evasion
turn_label_guide.rationale: Deflection on HOLD fact f:44 (no B-12 task) before its gate opens. Permitted by the profile, so not a fidelity failure, but an evasive event.

turn_label_guide.situation: Says he is not sure exactly when he left B-12.
turn_label_guide.label: genuine_uncertainty

turn_label_guide.situation: Avoids saying what he did inside B-12 when asked directly, before or after rec-04 is presented.
turn_label_guide.label: evasion
turn_label_guide.rationale: Omission or deflection on the CORE fact f:45 (the violation).

turn_label_guide.situation: Gives a partial answer to a question that bundles the task, the door and the timing.
turn_label_guide.label: poorly_framed_question
turn_label_guide.rationale: Compound question; label the question, not the subject.
